description: This Java interface defines a contract for obtaining metrics related to a 'Source' within the Eclipse Ditto framework, including methods for JSON serialization and accessing address metrics.

classes.name: SourceMetrics
classes.description: An interface representing metrics for a source, including JSON serialization and access to address metrics.

classes.name: SourceMetrics.JsonFields
classes.description: An immutable class defining JSON field constants for serialization of SourceMetrics.

methods.name: getAddressMetrics
methods.description: Returns a map of address strings to their respective AddressMetric objects, representing metrics for each source address.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the SourceMetrics to a JSON object, excluding hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the SourceMetrics to a JSON object with specified schema version and field selection, returning the relevant subset.
